ITEM 1 | Yellow grains, loose and separate with a slightly glossy, moist surface and a yellow-orange hue with some lighter flecks; mounded in the upper-left area of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 1.5 cm high, sitting beside the florets and the meat | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright green, dense, cone-shaped florets with a textured, spiky surface and lighter pale-green stems, slightly moist and tender-looking; clustered on the left side of the plate, about 7 cm across and 3 cm high, next to the yellow grains and leafy greens | 80
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-colored florets with a few yellow-green tips, matte and soft, lightly cooked; sitting in the lower-left area of the plate under and beside the green florets, about 5 cm across and 2 cm high | 45
ITEM 4 | Flattened pieces of light tan-to-golden meat with irregular edges, visible browning and darker speckled spots, slightly moist with a faint sheen, some herb-like flecks on the surface; laid in the center-right of the plate, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1.5 cm thick | 120
ITEM 5 | Dark green, glossy, wilted leaves with visible veins, moist and limp, clustered on the right and lower-center of the plate, spreading about 10 cm by 8 cm and 1 cm high | 70
